# Process Laboratories

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)

- Process Laboratories

#### **Services**

The Laboratory supports the academic programming of the Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Biology programs in the areas of transport, storage, and extraction of solids, liquids, and gases; distillation; heat exchange; agitation; mixing; sieving; instrumental chemistry; and bioprocesses.

The Unit Operations Laboratory features a complete pilot-type extraction system for different matrices, which includes crushing and extraction of the material until the final product is obtained, which can be oil-type, using the Supercritical Fluid Extractor, or in powdered form with the spray dryer.
